# POKÉKAYOU MOD
## For a dedicated cobblemon server

This mod id the official mod for the "Pokékayou 2" server, streamed on twitch. It adds a bunch of functionnality to make a Cobblemon server more welcoming and complete.

All the functionnalities of this mod come from players thoughts.

## FEATURES:

- **_Area protecting command managed with tags_**: Defines a persistant area associated with a tag. Non allowed players will not be able to break/place blocks in this area.

```
/pokezone <list/add/remove> [args]
```


- **_Custom music disks_**

- **_Vanilla chest locking_**: Allow to lock chests with an item (a Klefki), and to grant access to other players to chests with the key. Prevents locked chest from beiing destroyed by players.

- _**Custom "Vending Machine" shops**_: Allows to sell 5 différent items, managing the cost, per-sale item count, and activate/deactivate the sell per items. Stores the stock for you. It requires the mod CobbleDollars.
